summary: Eightco Holdings filed an 8-K on October 8, 2026, disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq Listing Qualifications compliance notice. The October 8 letter confirmed that for 10 consecutive business days, September 24 to October 7, 2026, ORBS closed at or above the $1.00 minimum bid price required by Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The prior deficiency notice dated August 5, 2026, covering June 23 to August 4, had granted until February 1, 2027 to cure. Nasdaq closed the matter; ORBS continues trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market. No deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations are stated.
